name: Suffolk County, MA
findings: Suffolk County has 5,214 nonprofit organizations. 1,706 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,469 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (10% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Suffolk County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Suffolk County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 104 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
